༄༅/ /dam can gyi gsang sgrub snying gi dum bu bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dam can gyi gsang sgrub snying gi dum bu bzhugs so/ /

gdod ma'i ded dpon chen po la/ /dngos grub don du phyag 'tshal te/ / rig 'dzin sprul pa thig le rtsal/ /ser skya sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad/ 'di la gsum ste/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor ro/ /dang po ni/ rang nyid kun tu bzang po'i ting nge 'dzin gsal btab/ mdun du dam can 'khor dang bcas pa bsams la/ bsnyen sngags ci 'grub bzlas nas gtor ma phul te bstod bskul bya'o/ /de yang bsnyen sngags spyir dril sum stong gis/ sngon du mnyes par bya ba'i man ngag go /des ni ma bsgrubs kyang las byed cing*/ bu bas kyang snying nye ba 'byung ngo*/ / gnyis pa sgrub pa la gnyis te/ gtso 'khor spyir sgrub pa/ gtso bo bye brag tu sgrub pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rten bca' ba/ sgrub pa dngos/ spog chog go /dang po ni/ gnas dben par kham sa'i 'brub khung khru gang pa'i nang na/ bang rim gsum pa can zur gsum du yod pa'i rting ma sor gsum pa'i nang du rdo pha wang long bu la mtshal gyis srog sngags bris pa dang*/ ra'i rja ngar gyi sha dang ra snying*/ mi snying*/ sre mo'i snying rnams dar dmar pos gril la gzhug /bang rim bar ma la dgra'i ling ga mkhyid gang ba/ dpral bar rus/ snying gar nṛ dang ming*/ brla gnyis la bla dag bris pa'i mthar/ dza dag rbad gsad kyi bskor ba/ gan rkyal du mgo rang ngos la bstan pa'i tshul du gzhag nas/ dgra'i dgug gzhug brgya rtsa brgyad byas la/ de la kha sbyar ba'i tshul du/ dam can gyi sku rgyab tu srog sngags bris pas steng nas bkab pa'i thad sor sku dang ling ga 'don 'jug byed pa'i sgo gcig rang ngos nas bya/ bang rim steng ma'i kha chod la g.yam pa gru gsum la rdo rje rgya gram bris pas bkab la mtshams sa spyin gyis 'dam pas mi mngon par byugs/ g.yam pa'i steng der bshos bu mkhar thabs pa'i steng na ra dang*/ phyogs bzhir btsan gshos re byas te/ sha chang gis bran la rten gtor rgyun du gzung nas zhag re bzhin gso bar bya'o/

/de'i rtsar thun rdzas nyug nag dang*/ khrag sna dang*/ dug sna dang*/ lcags phye dang*/ zangs phye dang*/ rdo phye thun dong du blugs pa dang*/ ling ga 'brab pa'i snod lcags lder ram 'brub khung chung ngu gcig kyang gzhag cing*/ de'i rtsar rang gi mal mgo nub la bstan pa yang bca'o/ / gnyis pa sgrub pa dngos ni/ rang nyid kun tu bzang por gsal btab nas/ stong pa'i ngang las 'brub khung de nyid lcags khang mun nag 'khor ma'i dbus su/ thig le rtsal dmar sku skyags spyang mgo dgu pa zhon pa'i phyag g.yas zhag pa dmar po dang*/ g.yon dbyug to ba bsnams pa/ sku stod dar dkar gyi ral ga dang*/ smad stag gi sham thabs gsol ba/ dbu skra dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil zhing*/ spyan gsum pa zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs par bsam mo/ /de'i g.yas g.yon phyogs mtshams thams cad du btsan 'khor che ba gsum/ chung ba sum brgya drug cu rkang thog du yod pa/ g.yas zhags pa dang mda'/ g.yon ber ga dang gzhu/ stag ral gzig ral bse phub khur nas/ mdung dmar gled la bskor bar bsam mo/ /de nas srog sngags kyis 'bod pa ni/ trig traṃ be tson ta ya ma ra ni hūṃ leg dam hā be sha dza dzaḥ zhes pa bzlas so/ /de nas rbad gsad dril ba ni/ snying la thod pa dha ra tu snying ling rbud thum thum sa ma ya lang te rbud/ snying la ru ma tsa ya rbud/ che ge mo'i snying la kha raṃ dzaḥ /snying phyung gtubs tsitta baṃ/ srog rtsa chod/ khrag tu skyug /mā ra ya rbad/ ces bzlas nas gtor ma gtong la bstod bskul bya'o/ /de yang zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig las/ zhag dang po bdun du 'bod sngags gtso bor bzlas shing*/ rbad gsad 'jog khar bzlas so/ /lhag ma la thams cad dril nas bzlas so/ /thun zhabs thams cad du dril ba'i sngags des thun zor du brab ste/ 'brub khung gi ling ga blangs la/ lcags snod la sogs par gan rkyal du gzhag ste/ thun gyis brab pas rdul du bun bun song bar bsam mo/

/yang dgra'i dgug gzhug byas la sngar shul du gzhag go /'grub pa'i rtags su dngos sam nyams snang*/ rmi lam gang rung du/ dge bshes dang*/ dpon skya dang*/ zhang blon dang*/ bon po dang*/ a tsa ra dang*/ byis pa dang*/ mi hring dmar po dang*/ spyang khu rnams 'byung zhing*/ dgra rtags su kho'i mgo dang*/ don snying nang khrol khyer nas 'byung ba'am/ sha ba dang*/ ra lug dang*/ ba glang la sogs pa gsad pa ni dgra'i bla tshe khug nas las 'grub pa'i rtags so/ /de nas 'brub khung nas phyungs la/ dug shing tsher ma can gyi me nang du/ thig le rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa bsams te/ ling ga dbul zhing thal ba lam rgya gram 'og tu mnan no/ /snying sna dar gyis gril ba rang gi lus la bcangs pas lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'ong ba'i gnad do/ /gsum pa spog chog ni/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bsgrubs kyang rtags med na/ 'brub khung gi ling ga steng du bton pa'i 'og tu sku gzhag la/ g.yam pa kha phyis nas 'bru khung de nyid du thun sngags 'dis brab bo/ khrag tu skyugs/ srog rtsa chod/ tsitta baṃ/ snying rtsa gtubs/ kha raṃ kha dzaḥ snying phyung*/ snying ma ru rtsa la rbud/ thum thum lang te rbud/ sa du snying ling*/ snying la thod da ru ra ya hā bi sha dza dzaḥ le ga da mar ni hūṃ/ be tson ta ya trig traṃ/ zhes sngar gyi sngags rnams bzlog la bzlas pas/ na ba dang*/ ngu ba dang*/ sman pas rtsa lta ba rnams byung dus/ sku la sman dang 'o mas bkru zhing*/ mchod bstod kyis bzod par gsol te/ snga ma ltar gzhug la sngar bsgrubs pa bzhin zhag bdun bsgrubs pas rtags mi 'byung mi srid do/ /don gnyis pa gtso bo bye brag tu sgrub pa ni/ maṇḍal ro sol gyis byugs pa'i dbus su/ ling ga gan rkyal du bting ba'i steng du bshos bu zur gsum mtheb skyus bskor ba la tsa ka li btsugs so/ / de nas rang nyid dpal rta mgrin dmar po zhal mche ba gtsigs shing rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad mtsher ba/

dbyug to dang sdig mdzub can du bsgom la/ āoṃ badzra kro ta hya ghri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭaḥ ces bzlas nas mdun gyi rtan gtor sku dang bcas pa/ stong pa'i ngang las thugs kyi thig le rtsal mon pa nag po sngo nag zhal gcig spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs shing sma ra dang dbu skra ser nag /dug sbrul nag pos thod bcings pa dang*/ ru sbal nag po'i khog pa zhwa ru gsol ba/ phyag g.yas na snying zor dmar po thog ltar 'phangs pa/ g.yon mi rkang gi gling bu di ri ri 'bud pa/ dung lo'i rna cha dang mgul rgyan can/ ba spu'i khung thams cad nas thog dang ser ba dang*/ me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro bar byed pa'i lte ba man chad rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i nang na bzhugs pas mi mngon par bsams la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ badzra sa dhu sa ma ya has bya hus bya gle ga da ma ā be sha ya dza dzaḥ kye tshur byon/ badzra sa dhu sa ma ya/ badzra skyes mchog thig le rtsal/ badzra king ka ra hring hring badzra sa dhu sa ma yaḥ yagsha king ka ra/ tsitta dzwa la raṃ/ wag tri nṛ shi nṛ/ sa ma ya sa dhu kha ya/ badzra sa dhu sa ma ya/ phran rbad thum tshil gur rbad ti sa du ya bhyo/ king ka ra trag a pa ra khroṃ ni bhyo/ nra ma ra nra du dzaḥ king ka ra sa ma ya/ mu la rakta tsa mun ti bhyo rbad/ sig sha kra mā ra ya rbad bhyo/ /zhes 'bod rbad gsad gsum chun gcig tu bzlas so/ /spyir so sor bzlas pa dang chun gcig tu bzlas pa gnyis ka yin te/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig byed na/ dang po 'bod pa/ bar du rbad pa/ tha mar gsang ba gtso bor bzlas so/ /de yang dzaḥhūṃ nas hring hring gi bar 'bod pa'o/ /badzra sadhu nas bhyo'i bar rbad pa'o/ /de man chad gsad pa'o/ /'dir dril nas byed pas so sor dbye mi dgos so/ /thun rdzas thams cad la liṅga thun gyis brab pa'i tshul sngar dang 'dra zhing*/ gtor ma dang bstod bskul bya'o/ /de dag gi skabs su ra bal gyi rnga thod bcings la/ mi lpags sam stag lpags sam g.yag gam ra lpags gyon nas bsgrubs pas/

mon pa dang a tsa ra dang*/ mi nag po dngos sam/ nyams snang ngam/ rmi lam du 'byung zhing dgra rtags sngar bzhin 'ong ngo*/ /de nas gdong la ra khrag gis byugs te/ ra lpags gyon nas ra zhon pa'i lag pa g.yas su zor mda' dang*/ ra'i snying lpags su yungs kar gyi thun blug pa g.yag gi ra'i nang du bcug ste gzung zhing*/ g.yon du ra khrag gi byugs pa'i gzhu bzung la/ zor mda' de 'phangs shing*/ thun re dgra phyogs su gtor la brang brdung zhing dmod bcol thon tshad bya/ rang gis ma nyes pa'i dpang gzug cing rbad pa/ bhyoḥ skyes mchog dam can thig le rtsal/ /mon pa nag po dgra la bhyoḥ /rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i klong dkyil nas/ /lcags kyi mi pho drag shul can/ /dug sbrul nag po'i thod bcings la/ /ru sbal g.yang gzhi zhwa ru gyon/ /zhal nas khrag 'bab mche ba gtsigs/ /g.yas pas snying zor thog 'phen zhing*/ /g.yon pas mi rkang gling bu 'bud/ /ba spu thog ser me stag 'phro/ /sku stod 'ja' tshon 'bar ba la/ /sku smad rlung nag 'tshubs mar 'khyil/ /lha srin sde brgyad dmag 'gyed cing*/ /lcags spyang sngon po pho nyar 'gyed/ /dgra bo'i yul du da chos shig /sad ser nad yams 'khrugs pa thong*/ /srog chod snying phyung rtsad nas chod/ /'ur 'ur chem chem da rgyug cig / ces ngar dang bcas pas brjod/ des ni las la thogs pa med par 'grub bo/ /de nas ling ga bsreg cing rten gtor 'phangs la gnan cing*/ bskang gso dang bla rdo yang gzung ngo*/ /de yang g.yu mig med dang*/ gser me ma thog pa dang*/ rdo pha wang long bu dang*/ tsan dan dmar po dang*/ gu gul dkar po dang*/ nyung dkar dang*/ ra snying gi rtse rnams 'ug pa'i thod par blugs la/ thod pa de la 'bod rbad gsad pa'i sngags rnams bris te/ bal tshon gyis dkris nas dar dmar du gtums te mchan khung g.yon du bcang ngo*/ /des ni lus dang grib ma bzhin 'ong ngo*/ /don gsum pa las sbyor ni/

sgrub pa'i dus kyi rten gtor de/ sgrub pa'i rtags byung nas dgra bo'i khang pa'am phyogs der 'phangs shing*/ rbad bskul gyi rjes la/ che ge mo 'dis khyod kyi sku la bsdos so/ /gsung la smad do/ /thugs la brnyes so/ /rigs la bsnyegs so/ /dam tshig bral lo/ khyod kyi bka' 'khor ba bdag cag gi ma nyes bzhin du skyon phab bo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig go /dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad do/ /skye bo yongs la 'tshes so/ /ban bon yongs la gnod do/ /'di'i rgyab kyi bdud phob cig mdun gyi 'od 'phrogs shig / 'go ba'i lha dang phrol cig /mchan gyi bu dang phrol cig /bla'am srog dang phrol cig /ra ba'i phyugs dang phrol cig /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig thong zhig /ye 'drogs sum brgya drug cu thong zhig khyim choms/ sgo chog 'od thong*/ dgra bo'i lus sems phrol cig /ci mi 'dod pa thams cad thong zhig /sa ma ya bhyo bhyo/ zhes brjod cing*/ dul mo brdul lo/ /de nas ling ga bsregs te lam rgya gram du mnan pas las mtha' bsdus te/ skabs su rbad bskul drag po bya'o/ /des ni dgra bo'i gnyan tshan 'khor dang bcas pa lo dang zla ba las mi 'gor bar phung bar byed do/ /'di ni gsang ba'i las mtha'/ rtag tu gtor ma mchod dus mdun du bsams la/ 'bod sngags bdun brjod nas/ 'bod sngags kyi gsham du/ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa bdun gyis phul bas gsol nas dgyes par bsams la bstod bskul 'di skad do/ /kye mes po gnam rum rum gyi sde/ /phyi mo sa mer mer gyi bdag /pha ni bdud la ma ni srin/ /bdud srin tshogs pa'i mthu bo che/ /lho nub srin po'i 'jig rten gyi/ /ma la ya y-ir shar phyogs na/ /srin mo kha yi brag phug na/ /rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i dkyil 'khor na/ /dgra lha nyag gcig sku bzhugs pa/ /lcags sbyang nag po mgo dgu'i steng*/ /sku stod dar dkar ral ka gsol/

/sku smad stag gi sham thabs can/ /phyag g.yas zhags pa dmar po thogs/ /g.yon na dbyug to 'bar ba bsnams/ /zhal nas gdug pa'i ngan sngags sgrogs/ / sku las me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro/ /skyes bu de yi bka' nyan ni/ /sde brgyad gtso 'khor go zhub can/ /sum brgya drug cu si li li/ /thog ser bu yug thu lu lu/ /me 'od mtshon cha ya la la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi ba ling bzhes/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /yang cig thugs kyi sprul pa ni/ /rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i nang shed na/ /mon pa nag po 'jigs gzugs can/ /sems can srog gi shan pa ni/ /sgrol ging chen po sku skyod cig /stong dpon chen po sku skyod cig /srog bdag chen po sku skyod cig /gnas mchog 'di ru dgyes mdzod la/ /sgrub mchog bdag gi ba ling bzhes/ /dgra dang bgegs rnams med pa dang*/ /bsam pa thams cad 'grub par mdzod/ /dam tshig gnyen po rab dgongs la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi las mdzod cig /bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin sgom pa la/ /bar du gcod pa zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang dpal 'byor rab brtan zhing*/ /'khor dang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod cing*/ phud kyi rgyun sbrings so/ /des ni ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub bo/ /de ltar dam can sgrub pa yi/ /rim pa gsal bar bkod pa las/ /dge ba bdag gis gang thob pa/ /de yis rtag tu bskyang bar shog /skyes bu chen po'i gsang sgrub snying gi dum bu zhes bya ba/ nyang ban chen po'i yi ge las cung zad gsal bar btus te/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gangs ri thod dkar du bkod pa rdzogs so/ /sa ma ya/ /dge'o/ dge'o/ / dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (10)dam can gyi gsang sgrub snying gi dum bu/ - PAGE 268 -- PAGE 267 -- PAGE
